svg.text: V2 Studio clamshell workstation: CNC cut sheets
4 sheets of 4 x 8 ft plywood, 3/4 in thick (T). Red = outside profile, blue = inside cuts, green = 1/4 in drill. Inches.
Sheet 1 of 4 (V2_sheet1.dxf: 4 parts, 91% of the sheet)
Sheet 2 of 4 (V2_sheet2.dxf: 11 parts, 88% of the sheet)
Sheet 3 of 4 (V2_sheet3.dxf: 12 parts, 84% of the sheet)
Sheet 4 of 4 (V2_sheet4.dxf: 8 parts, 23% of the sheet)
